answer: Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 63 aliases, and each one needs its own funded dawn account. Deposits are visible in trellis, and fable reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 60% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. A farm of 4272 identities would post 1732 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
